name: null-step-entry-keeps-the-rest
why: Same invariant as junk-step-entry-keeps-the-rest, for the one junk shape Windows handles differently. `{...null}` is the only spread that throws, so on Windows this makes the project unopenable AND removes it from Home — a harder failure to diagnose than an error would be.
divergence: macOS drops the null entry and keeps the valid step. Windows throws in normalizeSteps, so coerceManifest fails, openProject rejects, and the project vanishes from the listing.
